findings.detail: 'ob_bytes_object' is passed by address to _PyBytes_Resize(), which derefs *pv, with no NULL guard, but it can be NULL via a __new__/subclass bypass of tp_init (T.__new__(T) leaves it NULL). A guard such as 'ob_bytes_object != Py_None' or 'Py_IsNone(ob_bytes_object)' does NOT protect this — after the bypass the field is NULL. Add 'if (ob_bytes_object == NULL)' (or initialize it in tp_new) before the deref.

A guard such as 'ob_bytes_object != Py_None' or 'Py_IsNone(ob_bytes_object)' does NOT protect this — after the bypass the field is NULL. Add 'if (ob_bytes_object == NULL)' (or initialize it in tp_new) before the deref.

'type' is Py_INCREF'd via Py_NewRef() with no NULL guard, but it can be NULL via a __new__/subclass bypass of tp_init (T.__new__(T) leaves it NULL). A guard such as 'type != Py_None' or 'Py_IsNone(type)' does NOT protect this — after the bypass the field is NULL. Add 'if (type == NULL)' (or initialize it in tp_new) before the deref.
